description: Check a stack of two to ten tools against every CDP in CdpHub's directory, as the stack check on cdphub.com does: how many CDPs list all of them and which, those CDPs grouped by how they connect to each tool with each group counted, how they connect to each tool on its own with each group counted and a sentence for it, the CDPs that miss exactly one tool grouped by the tool they miss, and a link to the same check on cdphub.com. Use it for any question about two or more tools together, such as which CDPs fit a company's stack.

tools.description: The tools, for example ["Shopify", "Klaviyo", "Snowflake"]: two to ten.

name: check_stack
title: Check a stack
